posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
After reading that, I want to hear no complaints about the meta narrative stuff in the episode. >:V Which I found quite amusing this time around. Though I'm curious as to whether the Cult of Bloom is from the Plantverse or some kind of weird botanical Biomancer shenanigans. Or did Biomancer create the Plantverse, or rather, craft plant beings that would make us think there was another 'verse out there made of plant people? @_@ The possibilities are endless.

Anyway, I feel like someone referenced my fanfic, and that's just great. :D The new universe names are... Well, slightly confusing on the one hand and completely baffling on the other. What's a "Mist Storm"? c.c I probably forgot something.

Oh, and I loved the Cosmonaut's letter. Kudos to Adam for reading the Russian! :D

This was a fun episode, though entirely not what I was expecting. Moreover, I think there's an Editor's Note letter to be had, as they seemed to have glossed over something rather important regarding Wager Master's origins...
